subject: Intro: Finlytics (SI referral) — demo scheduling

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kelsey Thompson <kelsey@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Finlytics (SI referral) — demo request

Alex / Laura,

Quick intro — Kelsey is the Head of Product at Finlytics, a mid-market analytics ISV that was referred to us by TechConsult (SI partner). They signed up for a trial last week and want a live walkthrough focused on embeddings and retrieval use cases for their analytics UI.

Kelsey — great to meet you. Alex is one of our SDRs who will coordinate the demo and prep the right AE. Laura will be the AE on this deal.

Can we get 30–45 minutes on the calendar for a technical demo + short scoping discussion next week? Alex, can you propose a few slots?

Thanks — looping you both in.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (PDF)]

From: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Kelsey Thompson <kelsey@finlytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Finlytics (SI referral) — demo request

Hi Kelsey — great to meet you, and thanks Marissa for the intro.

Kelsey, welcome to Redwood — excited to chat. A few quick notes: I see you already created a trial account (thanks!) which helps us tailor the demo. Laura (AE) will lead the use-case part; we’ll also have a short technical walkthrough showing embedding search and token-cost tradeoffs.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed Apr 1, 10:00–10:45am
- Wed Apr 1, 2:00–2:45pm
- Thu Apr 2, 11:00–11:45am

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/45min

Also is it possible to include your engineering lead (CTO) on the call? Helps us answer architecture questions.

Agenda (high level):
- 10m: intros + goals
- 20m: demo (embeddings/retrieval + latency/cost controls)
- 10–15m: Q&A + next steps

Attached the one-pager Marissa shared so you have context.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
SDR, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0182
[Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks Alex — Wed Apr 1 at 2pm PST works for me. I'm going to include our CTO, Rajesh Singh (raj@finlytics.com) — he wants to understand how embeddings will fit into our product and questions around private deployment options. Would 45 minutes be OK?

A couple of quick asks for the session:
- Can you cover our typical data flow options (SaaS vs VPC) and what evidence you have for latency at 1k qps?
- We'd like to see an example of cost/latency tradeoffs with batching and quantization recommendations.

Looking forward — please send the invite and any pre-read.

Best,
Kelsey Thompson
Head of Product | Finlytics

Kelsey / Rajesh — thanks for confirming. Calendar invite sent for Wed Apr 1, 2:00–2:45pm PST (45m). Dial-in + Google Meet link included in the invite.

Attaching a short agenda and a brief pre-read that covers the private deployment options and a snippet of our benchmark summary (latency @1k qps). We’ll cover batching/quantization recommendations and a sample cost model during the demo.

Pre-reads attached: 20260401-finlytics-demo-agenda.docx, redwood-one-pager.pdf
